collection.title: Skoda Fabia Hatchback 2013 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Fabia Hatchback 2013 to 2014 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Skoda Fabia which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
